headline: United States GP: no session on Monday, race 25 October at 15:00 local
whyCareReason: Antonelli leads by 102 points. He can be champion in Austin only by winning the grand prix.
teaser: Nothing runs on 19 October. COTA is 23-25 October. Mercedes lead Ferrari by 134 points.
story: There is no Formula 1 session on Monday 19 October. Formula1.com lists the United States Grand Prix at the Circuit of the Americas for 23-25 October 2026, with the race on 25 October. The full timetable lists the grand prix at 15:00 local time and notes that the timetable can change. This desk does not convert that clock into US Eastern time. The circuit is 5.513 km, with 56 laps and a race distance of 308.405 km. The first grand prix there was in 2012. After Singapore, Kimi Antonelli has 340 points and George Russell 238, a gap of 102. Mercedes have 578 constructor points and Ferrari 444, a gap of 134. McLaren's 339 is the team total. RacingNews365's 19 October permutation says Antonelli can be champion in Texas only by winning the grand prix, which would take him to 365. That is a permutation, not a result. No Austin lap has a time.
stakes: The lead is 102 points with Austin, Mexico, Brazil, Las Vegas, Qatar and Abu Dhabi still to run. Nothing in Texas has been timed yet.
rivalryAngle: The championship does not move on a Tuesday. The next chance to move it is Austin.
funFacts: Formula1.com full timetable: United States GP, 23-25 October 2026, grand prix at 15:00 local time on 25 October. This desk does not convert that clock.
Circuit: 5.513 km, 56 laps, 308.405 km. Historical fastest lap on the circuit page: 1:36.169, Charles Leclerc, 2019.
Standings unchanged: Antonelli 340, Russell 238, gap 102. Mercedes 578, Ferrari 444, McLaren 339 constructors.
